policies.text: For a late Amazon delivery, check tracking and carrier notifications. The page advises allowing 48 hours beyond the estimated date for unexpected delays. For an unresolved Amazon-shipped order, contact Customer Service within 30 days of the estimate. For an order shipped and sold by a third-party seller, contact that seller. This page does not establish an individual order's status.
policies.demo_reply: I'm sorry for the delay. Please check tracking in Your Orders and any carrier notifications. If it's still unresolved after 48 hours past the estimate, contact Customer Service for an Amazon-shipped order.

policies.text: For a package marked delivered but missing, check the address in Your Orders, delivery notices or photos, the delivery area, and whether someone accepted it. The source advises allowing 48 hours because scanning can precede arrival. If unresolved, the next contact depends on whether Amazon or a third-party seller shipped the order. No refund or arrival can be guaranteed from a tweet.
